gap: The queue covers generation and storage only. Load requests (data centers, factories) are excluded, so questions about data center demand cannot be answered from this data.
Storage capacity for hybrids is often missing. LBNL imputes it in the published report but not in this file, so storage totals here are lower than the report's.

applies_to: projects.on_date, wd_date, ia_date, on_year, wd_year, ia_year, days_*
gap: Dates are incomplete. Always report how many projects had the date (e.g. 'based on N of M operational projects'). IA dates are especially thin in PJM (~3%), SPP (0%), NYISO and the Southeast.
Developer names are only populated in volume for ERCOT and NYISO (22% overall). Developer rankings elsewhere are not possible.

Cost studies end in 2021 (MISO, ISO-NE, NYISO), 2022 (PJM), 2023 (SPP) and 2024 (non-ISO). There are no cost data for CAISO, ERCOT, or most non-ISO utilities. Costs for requests submitted after those dates are not covered.
The cost files' status is a snapshot from when they were compiled. Join to projects for current status (q_status).
Costs are study estimates, not final paid costs. Early-stage studies (Feasibility) are less reliable than Facility studies.
The queue has county, not coordinates. Multi-county projects list only the first county.
EIA counties are mapped to FIPS via the queue's county names. Counties with no queue project get no FIPS, so a small share of existing capacity is missing from county_summary.
POI names are free text per operator. The same substation can appear under different spellings, so POI counts are approximate.

135 records reuse an (entity, q_id) already in the file, often a sparser copy of the same project (e.g. Duke|1 and Duke|1#2). They are kept and flagged with shares_q_id_with_other_record. For project counts that must not double count, exclude rows where project_uid contains '#'.
About 50 projects have an operation date before their queue date (usually uprates or re-filed requests). Their durations are set to null rather than negative.
16 requests list negative MW in the source (likely derates of existing plants). mw_1 keeps the raw value; mw_total is null for them and mw_note explains why.
ISO-NE has no operation dates in this file, so time-to-operation cannot be computed for ISO-NE.
Why a project withdrew is not recorded anywhere in this data. Cost can be correlated with withdrawal but not shown to cause it.
EIA-860 2025 is an early release and may change slightly in the final version.
